independent_review.accepted_scope: Bounded installed synthetic Debian ARM64 storage/recovery cohort with all runner-recorded limitations retained.

scope: Fresh installed Debian 13 ARM64 schema migration, retained-corruption repair atomicity and retry, physical retention grace, backup and separate credential recovery, config/TLS/service restoration, restart persistence, data-preserving removal and cleanup.

schema_lifecycle.evidence_limit: The transition values are runner-recorded because its raw stdout was not retained. Exact packages, final restored schema-59 state and current runtime checks are retained.

repair_atomicity.fixture: One runner-classified deletion-eligible expired parent with child binding, one runner-classified within-physical-grace parent, and one malformed unexpired parent with child binding.
repair_atomicity.expected_failure: Installed repair returned manifest deserialization failure.
repair_atomicity.retry: After deleting only the malformed fixture parent, installed repair deleted the eligible parent and cascaded child while retaining one runner-classified in-grace row.
repair_atomicity.post_grace: After the runner moved the retained fixture past its recorded cutoff, installed repair deleted it; both retired tables were empty and quick_check was ok.
repair_atomicity.boundary_evidence_limit: The retained counts prove the row-presence transitions, but expiry, cutoff and post-advance timestamps were not retained. The exact one-hour boundary and ordering are runner-recorded rather than independently reproducible from this bundle.

recovery.backup: Data backup created and immutably verified; generation and redacted installation identity matched.
recovery.credential_export: Separate AES-256-GCM export included the cursor signing key and no absent provider key material.
recovery.data_restore: Restored schema 59 catalogue passed quick_check with one synthetic source and vehicle and no retired rows.
recovery.credential_restore: Restored data had no secrets before the separate credential command; the recovered cursor key matched the original exactly.
recovery.host_state_restore: Configuration and TLS were restored from separate private host state, with only data_dir retargeted to the restored store. A bounded systemd ReadWritePaths drop-in admitted that path.
recovery.service_restore: The enabled packaged service started, all eight doctor checks passed, strict DNS-validating TLS health passed, restart changed PID, and identity/schema/data persisted.

calibrations: The initial one-use self-signed leaf was correctly rejected by the strict health client as CA-used-as-end-entity; a CA:true root and CA:false DNS leaf corrected the fixture without source changes.
The initial root-only recovery parent blocked service-user traversal before key generation; root:teslatlas 0710 corrected the fixture while host-state remained root-only.
Harness assertions were corrected to the emitted backup/restore status vocabulary and hub-cursor.key filename.

removal_and_cleanup.ordinary_remove: dpkg removal stopped and unloaded the service, removed the listener and binary, and preserved configuration, service user, schema-59 restored data, installation identity and one synthetic vehicle.
removal_and_cleanup.private_cleanup: After preservation evidence, the package was purged and the exact synthetic config, data, TLS, recovery, systemd drop-in, service identity and guest work root were removed.

limits: Synthetic core-only storage cohort; no real account, vehicle, collection, TeslaMate source or passive data.
No Fleet sidecars, container, macOS, App, Viewer, x86, Intel, Azure or production assertions.
Data backup reports cleanHostReady=false by contract; the clean-host-style route additionally required separately retained encrypted credentials, configuration, TLS and service-state reconstruction.
No package-byte reproducibility claim was added.
The retained bundle proves its final COMPLETE state, not a prior READY_FOR_CLEANUP state.
Retention counts prove the row transitions, but the exact one-hour grace classification and cutoff ordering are runner-recorded because expiry, cutoff and post-advance timestamps were not retained.
Independent review accepted this bounded cohort only with all preceding limitations retained.
